result.description:
Quality Assurance Officer (Full-Time).
Employer: Agri Storage & Logistics Pty Ltd 
Location: 10 Industrial Drive, Moree NSW 2400 
Employment Type: Full-Time 
Salary: $81.000

About Us
Agri Storage & Logistics Pty Ltd is currently seeking a reliable and detail-oriented Quality Assurance Officer to join our operations team on a full-time basis. This role is critical in ensuring that our agricultural storage and logistics processes consistently meet quality, safety, and regulatory standards.

About the Role
You will be responsible for maintaining and improving quality assurance systems across our storage and logistics operations, ensuring all products are handled and stored in compliance with relevant standards.

Key Responsibilities
•Carry out routine quality inspections of grain storage facilities
•Maintain compliance with safety standards, quality systems, and regulatory requirements
•Implement and review quality assurance procedures and documentation
•Collect grain samples and assist with testing to ensure product quality is maintained
•Investigate any quality issues and work with the team to resolve them effectively
•Maintain accurate records, reports, and audit documentation
•Support internal and external audits, including certification processes
•Work closely with operations staff to promote a strong quality culture
•Assist with staff training on quality procedures and compliance standards

Skills & Experience
•Degree in science, quality assurance, environmental health or a related field
•Previous experience in a similar QA role, ideally within agriculture, food handling, or logistics
